'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Hollingworth LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom Hollingsworth
* '''Deck name:''' LS Deck - MPC 2010
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
